name: usage-hub
description: Displays provider balance, local Codex token usage, session cost, and DeepSeek web bill data in a managed Windows overlay.

interface.shortDescription: Balance and token usage in a Codex-managed overlay
interface.longDescription: Usage Hub starts a managed Windows overlay with your provider balance, local Codex token usage, current-session cost, and optional exact DeepSeek web bill data. The plugin provides MCP tools, runtime status, overlay controls, and manual Edge extension setup guidance.
defaultPrompt: Show my current Codex usage and balance.
Check why the Usage Hub overlay is not updating.
Help me install the Usage Hub browser bridge.
